assertions.quoted_span: Where, based on the surveys referred to in Article 10, the specified pest has not been detected in a demarcated area for a period of four years
assertions.claim: The remediated basis goes beyond the source by declaring that the period counts only where every Article 10 survey covers the area and that any gap leaves four years unproven; Article 6(1) requires the no-detection conclusion to be based on Article 10 surveys but states no clock-stopping or automatic non-proof rule for a gap, so the field fails Source fidelity through Remediation drift.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Retain Article 10 annual surveys of the entire demarcated area as the evidentiary basis, but remove the invented rule that a survey-stream gap automatically prevents the four-year period from elapsing; leave the legal sufficiency of incomplete evidence unresolved unless Stage A expressly settles it.
assertions.falsifier: A retained source span or binding Stage A ruling expressly establishes that any gap in Article 10 annual survey coverage prevents the Article 6(1) four-year condition from being satisfied, regardless of the other survey evidence held.

assertions.quoted_span: establishment of the demarcated area, which follows the demarcating finding and is itself the last detection at that moment
assertions.claim: The new start-event text grammatically identifies establishment of the demarcated area as itself a detection, although establishment is a legal act and the demarcating finding is the detection, making the anchor denotation internally false through Remediation drift.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Rewrite the start event without equating establishment with detection—for example, state that establishment follows the demarcating finding, which is the last held detection at establishment unless a later detection is recorded.
assertions.falsifier: The quoted field is authoritatively defined so that 'is itself the last detection' refers to the demarcating finding rather than to the grammatical subject, establishment of the demarcated area.

assertions.quoted_span: any time they consider that an audit is necessary
assertions.claim: The newly minted clock is typed as promptness_standard even though the source creates an obligation on each occurrence of the authority's necessity determination and supplies no immediate, without-delay, timely, or other promptness standard, failing Kind and bound through Remediation drift.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Represent the provision as an event-triggered audit obligation or recurrence with no cadence or deadline, adding an event-triggered kind if the current enum cannot express that relation, rather than labelling it a promptness standard.
assertions.falsifier: A binding Stage B convention defines promptness_standard as a cadence-free event-triggered obligation that carries no implication of urgency or speed.

checked_sound: Exhaustively reread all 72 clocks, in canonical artifact order, against their producer Stage A source_quote spans for anchor denotation; legal-state object, medium and place; kind and bound; magnitude, unit and comparator; consequence and completion; version interval; and vocabulary.

Confirmed that B-CLK-EU-625-39-audit-recurrence now encodes the Article 37(4)(e) accreditation-assessment redundancy exception in applies_when rather than only in its note; the exception grammatically qualifies the Article 39(1) audit duty and does not improperly narrow it.

Confirmed that B-CLK-EU-625-39-audit-on-necessity separately represents the second Article 39(1) trigger and anchors it on the competent authority's own determination concerning the designated laboratory; the surviving defect is its promptness_standard kind, not the trigger's denotation.

Confirmed that the Article 6(1) anchor correctly identifies the Article 10 annual surveys and their entire-demarcated-area scope as the evidentiary basis; the defect is the additional survey-gap rule, which the quoted provisions do not state.

Apart from the reported cycle-3 remediation defects, the remaining clocks preserve their source triggers, populations, timing relations, magnitudes, units, completion acts, mutually exclusive alternatives and effective intervals.

Exhaustively checked all 13 floor parameters, the one ceiling parameter and all four threshold parameters against their source phrases and producer quotes; the values, units and inclusive or strict comparators remain faithful, including the strict greater-than 5 km island threshold and the unresolved Cq boundary values.

Checked every distinct confidence/prevalence design pair against its producer quote: Union pairs preserve floor confidence at 80%/1%, 90%/0.5%, 90%/0.7%, 90%/1% and 95%/1%, while PNI pairs preserve exact 95%/0.05%, 95%/0.09%, 90%/0.7% and 80%/1% values after proportion-to-percent normalization.
Confirmed that all 72 clocks and all 53 parameters resolve to producer rows in the scoped Stage A authoring files and that every clock source_phrase occurs in its producer source_quote.

Confirmed the previously remediated eligibility thresholds, four DDS 31/DDS 45 48-hour waits, almond pre-removal treatment ordering constraint, calendar-day authorization unit, Article 5 version changes, Article 7 per-plant clocks, Article 13 flight-season alternatives and Article 42 one-renewal limit remain source-faithful.

Confirmed that operative vocabulary remains faithful across the population: host plants and specified plants are not substituted, defined terms carry no definiens annotations, and immediate or without-delay duties remain unnumbered.
